description: Search and analyze every Taiwan court judgment offline, with a citation graph, sentencing analytics, and watchlists no judicial.gov.tw page surfaces.

tools.name: find_run
tools.description: Run a search across courts, case types, year, case-character, and keyword filters; returns judgment metadata. Optional: court, type, year (plus 10 more).

params.name: court
params.description: Court code(s) — comma-separated, e.g. TPS,TPH,TPD. Use 'case-types courts' to list all 41 courts.

params.name: type
params.description: Case type(s) — comma-separated. Long form: criminal,civil,administrative,disciplinary,constitutional. Short form: M,V,A,P,C.

params.name: year
params.description: 民國 (ROC) year, e.g. 115. Single year.

params.name: case-char
params.description: 字別 (case character), e.g. 台抗, 毒抗, 訴, 簡上

params.name: no-end
params.description: Case number end of range (defaults to 'no' value)

params.name: from
params.description: Date range start (民國 YYY/MM/DD or Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: to
params.description: Date range end (民國 YYY/MM/DD or Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: keyword
params.description: Free-text keyword across the judgment body

params.name: limit
params.description: Max results to return (default 20, max 100 per page)

tools.name: judgments_get
tools.description: Fetch a single judgment by JID (e.g. TPSM,115,台抗,703,20260430,1) with full text and metadata. Required: jid. Optional: with-pdf (default: false). Returns the Judgment.

params.name: with-pdf
params.description: Also download the PDF attachment (when present)

tools.name: judgments_list
tools.description: List recently-synced judgments from the local store, with optional court/type/date filters. Optional: court, type, limit (default: 50). Returns array of Judgment.

tools.name: knowledge_get
tools.description: Fetch a single knowledge-base case commentary by its par-token. Required: par. Returns the KnowledgeDoc.

tools.name: knowledge_search
tools.description: Full-text search the Judicial Knowledge Base. Required: query. Optional: court, case-char, no. Returns array of KnowledgeDocRef.

tools.name: knowledge_topic
tools.description: Fetch a single knowledge-base topic with its case-commentary list. Required: id. Returns the KnowledgeTopicDetail.

params.name: id
params.description: Topic ID (e.g. 474 for 法律行為)

tools.name: knowledge_topics
tools.description: List all 462 knowledge-base topics with their IDs and titles. Returns array of KnowledgeTopic.
